entries.name: Agent
entries.summary: Smartphone with a learning assistant AI: calls, Data Pool search, schedule, shopping, recording. Gives +2 to Library Search and Wardrobe & Style while you wear what it suggests; several Agents do not stack.

entries.name: Airhypo
entries.summary: Injects a drug with compressed air; one dose takes an action. Against an unwilling target a Medtech makes a melee attack and on a hit delivers the dose instead of damage.

entries.name: Gas mask
entries.summary: Filters the air: the wearer is immune to toxic gases and fumes that must be inhaled.

entries.name: Audio recorder
entries.summary: Records up to 24 hours of audio onto a standard memory chip.

entries.name: Active earmuffs
entries.summary: Ear protection: the user cannot be deafened by loud noises such as flashbangs.

entries.name: Binoculars
entries.summary: Magnifies what you see two to three times.

entries.name: Braindance viewer
entries.summary: Plays braindances — recordings of lived experience felt from the performer's point of view.

entries.name: Bug detector
entries.summary: Beeps when a listening bug or similar device is within 2 m.

entries.name: Carryall
entries.summary: A tough bag of any size, from a shoulder bag to a duffel.

entries.name: Chemical analyzer
entries.summary: Takes an action to identify a substance's chemical makeup against a large sample database.

entries.name: Computer
entries.summary: A laptop or desktop for documents and browsing the Data Pools.

entries.name: Cryopump
entries.summary: Case with a bag and a pump: a patient in stasis makes no death saves for a week while the bag has at least 1 HP. 1 charge (refill 50 eb), one adult; the bag is cover with 15 HP. Medtechs only.

entries.name: Cryotank
entries.summary: A human-sized capsule: after a successful Medical Tech check (DV 13) the patient stays in stasis as long as needed; HP recover twice as fast inside. Cover with 30 HP. Medtechs only.

entries.name: Cyberdeck (excellent quality)
entries.summary: 9 slots for programs and hardware to work in the NET; needs an interface plug and a neurolink.

entries.name: Cyberdeck (poor quality)
entries.summary: 5 slots for programs and hardware to work in the NET; needs an interface plug and a neurolink.

entries.name: Cyberdeck (standard quality)
entries.summary: 7 slots for programs and hardware to work in the NET; needs an interface plug and a neurolink.

entries.name: Burner phone
entries.summary: A cheap phone nobody tracks, favoured by Fixers and anyone avoiding surveillance.

entries.name: Drum synthesizer
entries.summary: Plastic pads of various sizes that imitate drums; needs an amplifier to be heard.

entries.name: Duct tape
entries.summary: Sticky tape, sometimes glow-in-the-dark — handy for marking tunnels, hazards and caches.

entries.name: Electric guitar or other instrument
entries.summary: An electronic instrument of your choice; it needs an amplifier to be heard.

entries.name: Flashlight
entries.summary: Shines 100 m for 10 hours, then needs recharging.

entries.name: Food stick
entries.summary: A cereal snack bar; the taste is usually awful.

entries.name: Glow paint
entries.summary: Glow-in-the-dark spray paint for marks and graffiti.

entries.name: Glow stick
entries.summary: A disposable tube that lights a 4 m square for 10 hours.

entries.name: Grapple gun
entries.summary: Fires a hook up to 30 m as an action; the line (10 HP) holds twice the user's weight, no climbing penalty, can be let go without an action. Useless as a weapon, cannot be used to grab.

entries.name: Handcuffs
entries.summary: Easily broken by anyone with BODY above 10.

entries.name: Tracker
entries.summary: Tracks its paired button-sized beacon up to 1 km; an extra beacon costs 50 eb.

entries.name: Inflatable bed and bedroll
entries.summary: A self-inflating bed with a thin sleeping bag; folds into a 15×15 cm pack.

entries.name: Kibble pack
entries.summary: A foil pack of dry flakes or wafers — one meal.

entries.name: External exoskeleton ß (beta)
entries.summary: While connected, raises the user's BODY to 12 (no higher); HP and death save stay the same. Needs 1 interface plug.

entries.name: External exoskeleton ∑ (sigma)
entries.summary: While connected, raises the user's BODY to 14 (no higher); HP and death save stay the same.

entries.name: Lock-picking set
entries.summary: A small kit of tools for opening mechanical locks.

entries.name: Medscanner
entries.summary: Diagnoses injuries and illness without surgery. +2 to First Aid and Paramedic; several medscanners do not stack.

entries.name: Medtech bag
entries.summary: A kit of medical tools from surgical staplers to scalpels — all you need to save lives.

entries.name: Memory chip
entries.summary: A compact digital storage chip, available in various sizes.

entries.name: MRE
entries.summary: A self-heating ration: add water and in a couple of minutes you have a hot meal.

entries.name: Personal care pack
entries.summary: Toothbrush and paste, wipes, a comb, depilatory cream and the like.

entries.name: Pocket amplifier
entries.summary: The size of a thick book; sound carries 100 m for about 6 hours, drives two instruments at once; needs charging.

entries.name: Radar detector
entries.summary: Beeps when radar is active within 100 m.

entries.name: Radio communicator
entries.summary: A headset for radio contact up to 1 km.

entries.name: Radio scanner / music player
entries.summary: Plays music from a chip or the Data Pool and finds active radio bands within 1 km; encrypted stations need a descrambler.

entries.name: Flare
entries.summary: Disposable, lights a 100 m square for an hour; comes in several colours.

entries.name: Rope (60 m)
entries.summary: Nylon rope that holds up to 360 kg.

entries.name: Scrambler / descrambler
entries.summary: Encrypts outgoing messages; the descrambler is included.

entries.name: Smart glasses
entries.summary: Two slots for cybereye options that give their benefits; options always count as a pair, priced as one eye. Only one pair can be worn.

entries.name: Tech bag
entries.summary: A repair kit for electronics and machinery: multitool, electrical supplies, screws and bolts, torch, modules, pry bars and a hammer.

entries.name: Techscanner
entries.summary: Diagnoses machinery and suggests repairs. +2 to Basic Tech, Cybertech, Land, Sea and Air Vehicle Tech, Electronics/Security Tech and Weaponstech; does not stack with itself.

entries.name: Multitool
entries.summary: An all-in-one tool: a blade, pliers, screwdrivers, files and tongs in one case.

entries.name: Tent and camping gear
entries.summary: A one-person tent, a self-heating kettle (the battery lasts 2 hours, recharges in 5 minutes) and a cheap fork.

entries.name: Biotoxin vial
entries.summary: Applied to a light melee weapon as an action for 30 minutes: instead of damage a fleshy target makes a Resist Torture/Drugs check (DV 15) and on a failure takes 3d6 ignoring armor (armor is not damaged).

entries.name: Poison vial
entries.summary: Applied to a light melee weapon as an action for 30 minutes: instead of damage a fleshy target makes a Resist Torture/Drugs check (DV 13) and on a failure takes 2d6 ignoring armor (armor is not damaged).

entries.name: Video camera
entries.summary: Records up to 12 hours of video with sound onto a standard memory chip.

entries.name: Virtuality goggles
entries.summary: A headset that overlays cyberspace on the real world. Not only for netrunners: handy for seeing the control panels of gear you plug into.
